label: Government Effectiveness (WGI estimate)
source: World Bank, Worldwide Governance Indicators (Kaufmann and Kraay)
notes: Perceptions of the quality of public services, the civil service and its independence from political pressures, policy formulation and implementation, and the credibility of the government commitment to such policies. Estimate of the governance score in units of a standard normal distribution, from about -2.5 (weak) to +2.5 (strong), built from many survey and expert sources (Kaufmann and Kraay). Scores are relative to other countries in the same year, so a flat line can hide a change in absolute terms, and a score has a margin of error. Survey years: 1996, 1998, 2000, then every year from 2002. Country rows only (no aggregates); 9 territories without an ISO3 code in the World Bank country list are left out (Anguilla, Cook Islands, French Guiana, Jersey, Martinique, Netherlands Antilles, Niue, Reunion, Taiwan, China). World Bank API source 3, last updated 2026-09-25.
